## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~20.7GB
llama cli -hf mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~36.5GB
llama cli -hf mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~20.7GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~36.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~19.3GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-4bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~36.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-8bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~20.7GB
ollama run hf.co/mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~36.5GB
ollama run hf.co/mradermacher/Yi-1.5-34B-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**MLX (Mac)** · install: with uv `uv tool install mlx-lm` · or `pip install mlx-lm` · Apple silicon Macs only, text only.

```sh
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~19.3GB
mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-4bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-4bit
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~36.5GB
mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-8bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Yi-1.5-34B-8bit
```

**Other engines**

```sh
# 16-bit bf16 · ~68.78GB
uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' --with accelerate python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='01-ai/Yi-1.5-34B', torch_dtype='auto', device_map='auto')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
```
